The Vtuber I'd like you to draw is "Shinozuki Yona," and I'd like her depicted watching TV in her loungewear and round glasses. Since she often does simultaneous viewing streams, it would be great if it conveyed the feeling of watching together.　
 
Please ensure her head isn't cut off so it can be used for thumbnails. Also, it would be greatly appreciated if the delivered files could be transparent PNGs or PSD files with the character layer isolated. 【Character Features】 ・White lion motif ・Ear piercings ・Neck choker ・Hair with a white to light blue gradient ・Her companion lion cub has faint whiskers
